name: Tonitor
intro: Not a groovebox: six free-running tracks of algorithm-drawn sound objects for ambient and electroacoustic music, six engines, free loopers, no tempo. Pick a track, tap HOME for a new sound, play the white keys.

rows.what: Track 1; SEL, ENV, LFO, EDIT, GLO are tracks 2-6.
Track's engine: FM, ANIMA, CALIGULA, RUSSOLO, DRUID, BAYAREA.
Track level, OFF to +4.5 dB.
Track pan.
Track octave down (OCT+ up), -3 to +3.
SCALE page: SELECT root, ALGORITHM scale; ARP again: back.
0.8 s: copy track 1; hold another track's button: paste.
A new generated sound for the chosen track.
SHIFT: a new sound of the same family.
Play the chosen track in the scale, root on key 1.
SHIFT latches the held notes as a drone.
On a lit (latched) key: let it go.
AMBIENT path for new sounds (key 2: EXPERIMENTAL); again: OPEN.
0.6 s: chord mode on / off; tap: next chord form.
DJ filter: left low-pass, right high-pass, middle off.
Granulator: left dark, right scatter, middle off.
Crush: left fewer bits, right lower sample rate.
SHIFT: distortion, 0-100.
EDIT: KNOB 1-4 become the sound's four macros.
ENVELOPE page: KNOB 1-4 attack, decay, sustain, release.
Back to the sound's own envelope (AS DRAWN).
Arm a free loop; first note starts, REC ends; again: overdub (10).
1 s: empty all the chosen track's loops.
Stop / restart the chosen track's loops.
Take loop 1-10 out, or bring it back in.
Every track's loops off, or all on together.
VARY: loops vary notes, levels and pace; again: off.
Loops REVERSE (5 PENDULUM, 6 RANDOM); again: forwards.
Loops half speed (8: double); again: normal.
All loops one scale step up (OCT- down).
BALLSY bouncing-ball sequencer on / off; KNOB 1-4 set it.
Track's reverb send (starts at 40).
SHIFT: track's delay send.
REVERB page: KNOB 1-4 SIZE, DECAY, DAMP, MIX.
DELAY page: KNOB 1-4 TIME, FEEDBACK, DAMP, MIX.
SESSIONS: PRESETS picks slot 1-64, SAVE loads (empty: new session).
0.8 s: save the session; first time confirm YES with SAVE.
Save into the slot shown; over a session turn to YES.
Engine's 64 presets: SAVE loads, hold SAVE stores.

tips: No tempo, no grid: every loop has its own length, so overdubs drift in and out of phase.
The black keys play no notes; the rightmost one is SHIFT for every combination on this sheet.
A held or latched note keeps sounding while you choose and play another track.
Twelve voices are shared by all tracks; CALIGULA and RUSSOLO are one organism per track, silent until a key is down.
Saving a session overwrites projects, presets or samples another firmware left in the FM-1's user flash.
Something wrong after an update? Hold OCT- while powering on: RESCUE screen for reinstalling.
checked: c66bf8d firmware/src/ui.c enums: B_FX..B_OCTUP printed-label order, LAYER_BTN = FX SEL ENV LFO EDIT GLO = tracks 1-6; EN_PRESET engine (NENG 6, layers.c ENG_NAME FM ANIMA CALIGULA RUSSOLO DRUID BAYAREA), EN_SELECT level (VOL / OFF), EN_ALGO pan, OCT -3..+3.

ui.c key defines: KEY_AMB 1, KEY_EXP 3, KEY_CHORD 5 (held 600 ms toggle, else next form), KEY_REV 8, KEY_PEND 10, KEY_RAND 13, KEY_HALF 15, KEY_DOUBLE 17, KEY_ENV 20 (SHIFT: env_on off, AS DRAWN), KEY_EDIT 22 (SHIFT: bb_toggle BALLSY; held 600 ms while running: page), KEY_SHIFT 25; white_ix<0 keys play no notes.

ui.c ui_input: track button held 800 ms = clip_copy / clip_paste (not with SHIFT); HOME new_sound(SHIFT=same family); SHIFT+REC VARY; REC press EV_LOOP_REC, held 1000 ms EV_LOOP_CLEAR; PLAY tap EV_LOOP_PLAY, held 450 ms = loops on white keys (EV_LOOP_TRK); SHIFT+PLAY all loops off/on; SHIFT+OCT lx transposition (with track button: lxt).

ui.c: SCALE page (ARP) EN_ALGO = scale (9 scales), EN_SELECT = root; SEQ = REVERB page, SHIFT+SEQ = DELAY page, KNOB 1-4 = rvp/dlp; KNOB 1 flt, 2 gr, 3 cr, 4 send; SHIFT+KNOB 3 dist, SHIFT+KNOB 4 dsend; EDIT -> mac; env_page -> ADSR.

ui.c save_short / save_long / pre_short / pre_long: SAVE tap = SESSIONS page (PRESETS slots 1-64; SAVE loads or ses_fresh on empty); SAVE held 800 ms saves over current, else asks first empty (YES default), in list asks for slot shown (OVERWRITE NO default); SHIFT+SAVE presets page, SAVE loads, held saves.
main.c 495 + recovery.c recovery_key + bootguard.h bootguard_manual: OCT- alone at power-on or two failed boots -> RESCUE screen.
unsure: README's 'hold OCT- and OCT+ for five seconds: UBOOT' not found in Tonitor's code (bootguard comment: both keep calibration); left off the sheet.
ui.c header comment is stale: says ARP page 'SELECT the scale, ALGORITHM the root', two voices, engines FM/ANIMA; the code (and README) do SELECT root, ALGORITHM scale. Sheet follows the code.

BALLSY knobs (balls, speed, wall octaves, instability), SHIFT + track button + OCT (one track's loops), presets' four-a-page layout, MIDI in: left out or only summarised; BALLSY knob meanings taken from README, bb_knob not read in detail.
